social.text: Sonny's side of the Horse is Hea game moved big this morning with no points on the board, so the swing is coming from lineup news. Worth watching what he does with the rest of that roster before kickoff.

social.text: Zoe cut A.J. Brown for Omarion Hampton and Sonny is swapping a Ravens defense for a receiver nobody has seen yet. Wednesday is chaos season on the wire.
